question: **What is the estimated world population by the middle of this year?**
solution:
The correct answer is: **8.045 billion**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The first sentence of the paragraph states, "*China and India together will account for more than a third of the estimated global population, which is expected to hit 8.045 billion by mid-year,...*"
 
• So, the estimated world population by the middle of this year is **8.045 billion**.
 
• The question is asking for the estimated population, which means it is not a definite or exact number.
 
• It is important to keep track of the world population as it affects resources, environment, and social systems.
 
• The estimated world population continues to increase, which can have both positive and negative impacts.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1.256 billion** is the estimated population of India as of **2021**.
 
• **900 million** is less than the population of India, so it cannot be the estimated world population.
 
• **1.411 billion** is close to the estimated population of India, but it is still not the correct answer for the estimated world population.
